title: Tofu chickpea tahini bowl
summary: Tofu chickpea tahini bowl is a middle eastern dinner built around firm tofu and canned chickpeas in water, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Cook firm tofu for Tofu chickpea tahini bowl in a lightly oiled pan until just done, and cook or warm cucumber alongside.
steps.tip: Keep the heat lively so a bowl supper still tastes cooked, not assembled from cold jars.

steps.instruction: Toss canned chickpeas in water with lemon or lime, herbs and a pinch of salt.
Pile the protein, salad and any grain into bowls.
Spoon over yoghurt, tahini or the pan juices and serve Tofu chickpea tahini bowl straight away. Taste Tofu chickpea tahini bowl before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.
